title: The $k$-cube has a perfect matching
statement: For every integer $k \ge 2$, the $k$-cube $Q_k$ admits a perfect matching: there is a set of edges of $Q_k$, no two sharing a vertex, that together cover every vertex.
replaced:
Ex 5.1.1(a): every \texttt{k}-cube (\texttt{k $\ge$ 2}) has a perfect matching.

\textbf{5.1.1} (a) Show that every $k$-cube has a perfect matching $(k \geq 2)$.
